Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Proposed immigration ban for AIDS infected persons 2. Bunceton, Missouri, openly gay mayor Gene Ulrich elected to fourth term 3. Seattle, lawyers guild attempts to block anti-gay activists from repealing protective ordinance, Council of Churches supports gay civil rights 4. Andy Humm on censoring yourself and gay liberation COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse sale 5. Interview with Connie Cohrt of the Greater Gotham Business Council 6. ICN, makers of Ribavirin, artificially inflated price of the drug in Mexico 7. Texas, first national AIDS hospital plans approved 8. National Cancer Institute renders AIDS virus harmless in the lab 9. Houston, Texas, council advises against health card proposal COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 10. Sports Report 11. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Doug Marcino, a volunteer in the Speaker's Bureau of GMHC's Education Department, on providing informational outreach about GMHC 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: E-Z Trim exercise equipment 2. Interview with author Gordon Merrick on his book "A Measure of Madness" COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Review of "Desert Hearts" film COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity with Dear Abby 4. Interview with organizers of "Hocus Pocus" fundraiser event for children with AIDS, cuts off
